variants.headline: Home world changes the charter
variants.sub: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has changed the colony's charter. A change to the governing framework deserves a precise account, not a guess at the powers affected. In considering {target}, readers should distinguish the fact of amendment from any particular new permission or restriction not specified in this report.

The charter has changed. It may sound like a subject for a very long document, and it is still a subject for the people who live under it. Ask about authority. Ask about fairness. Do not accept a made-up list of new powers just because the word 'charter' sounds impressive.

We support {target} in this assessment. A charter change deserves judgment on its merits, rather than condemnation merely because the framework has been altered by an authority exercising its claimed role. Readers deserve a clear story and a straight answer about responsibility.
